title: Contents Packout & Storage — Vault Storage Charged for the Period in Which the Return Falls
content:
**Q. How much of a vault storage period is charged when the contents' return is scheduled inside it?**

A. For the Contents Packout & Storage vault storage billed to the customer on a Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout job, the fraction of the vault storage period charged follows the scheduled return, the days being counted from the period's first day through the scheduled return date with both of those days counted: when the job is in return scheduled status, its scheduled return date falls inside the period being billed and those days number at least the half-period days, the fraction is those days divided by the tier's period length; when the job is in return scheduled status, its scheduled return date falls inside the period being billed and those days number fewer than the half-period days, the fraction is the half-period days divided by the tier's period length; in every other case, including a job with no scheduled return date, the fraction is one.

**Q. Does this apply to every storage line?**

A. No. For a customer-billed vault storage line on those tiers, and only for such a line, the period in which the scheduled return falls is charged for the fraction stated here; a declared-value coverage line priced under the declared-value coverage rule remains under that rule, and every other storage line, including every other declared-value coverage line, still stops accruing with the storage period in which the contents are returned, billed in full, and no period starting after the returned date is billed.

**Q. Which period is "the period being billed"?**

A. The storage period, counted in whole periods of the tier's period length from the custody start date, that contains the day the line is charged.

**Q. What is the half-period figure?**

A. 15 days.

## Fraction table (30-day period length)

| Job status | Scheduled return date | Days from the period's first day through the return date, both counted | Fraction |
|---|---|---|---|
| return scheduled | inside the period being billed | 15 or more | those days divided by 30 |
| return scheduled | inside the period being billed | fewer than 15 | 15 divided by 30 |
| return scheduled | outside the period being billed | — | one |
| any other status | any, or none | — | one |

## Cases (hypothetical dates, 30-day period starting on the 5th of a month)

- Return scheduled for the 25th of that month: the 5th through the 25th is 21 days counted both ends; the fraction is 21 divided by 30.
- Return scheduled for the 9th: 5 days, fewer than 15; the fraction is 15 divided by 30.
- Return scheduled for the 19th: exactly 15 days; the fraction is 15 divided by 30, reached as those days divided by 30.
- The job still in custody with no scheduled return: the fraction is one.
